name: lemma-content
description: Lemma theological studies — canonical content + site + tooling (monorepo root)

scripts.copy-pdfs: for d in studies/*/; do slug=$(basename "$d"); mkdir -p "site/public/studies/$slug"; if [ -d "${d}versions" ]; then cp -r "${d}versions" "site/public/studies/$slug/"; fi; done
scripts.site:build: npm run copy-pdfs && cd site && npm run build
